findings.published_specification: Section 4.2 uses logistic masks strictly in (0,1) summing to k; Algorithm 1 masks means and resolves the unrestricted portfolio.
findings.released_behavior: Every weight remains a free variable in the second n-asset QCQP.
findings.diagnostic: Training-window real-data soft OSCAR portfolios are dense even while mask mass equals k. Exact nonzero cardinality cannot be inferred from gate mass.
findings.proposed_correction: Hard support restriction would change the end-to-end optimization/gradient; existing corrected adaptation already implements its own separately labeled choice.

findings.published_specification: Eq. (5) says covariance = L L.T, but uses norm(L y) as the risk norm.
findings.identity: The quadratic portfolio variance is y.T @ covariance @ y = norm(L.T @ y)^2; norm(L @ y)^2 uses L.T @ L instead.
findings.evidence: Existing synthetic audit upstream_audit.json plus exact matrix identity; this bug is also in the publication, rather than only a release/paper discrepancy.

findings.implication: Changes the feasible conic set and potential infeasibility behavior; do not silently equate the two formulations.

findings.published_specification: Algorithm 1 per-sample squared Euclidean norm; Eq. (14) averages squared-vector norms over samples.
findings.released_behavior: losses.MSE averages squared errors over assets inside each sample.
findings.implication: The effective mixed-loss relative scaling differs by the number of assets, in addition to undocumented return standardization choices.

findings.published_specification: Table 1 caption states Historic estimates use the full training set; rolling covariance is specified elsewhere.
findings.released_behavior: Historic mean uses each look-back window, which changes over the test period.
findings.implication: Which Historic specification produced the published table is unresolved.

findings.published_specification: Appendix B.2 repeatedly adjusts the SDP sparsity parameter to match actual selected cardinality.
findings.released_behavior: Uses fixed nominal k and leading eigenvector; no matching search or selection threshold is released.
findings.diagnostic: All completed first-window SDR checks return dense rounded portfolios.
findings.missing: Search range, update rule, numerical nonzero threshold, convergence/failure policy, and resulting per-case sparsity parameters.

findings.released_behavior: Fits StandardScaler on the entire panel before chronological split; estimates covariance/forecasts in standardized security units, then applies weights to raw returns.
findings.implication: Release behavior has test-distribution leakage and different risk units; correcting it changes the target computation. The paper does not specify the full preprocessing choice.

findings.published_specification: 512/256 hidden layers, batch64, lr=.001, alpha=.5, five repeated runs. Algorithm 1 has a loop over batches inside each epoch.
findings.released_behavior: Defaults are 256/128 and batch32; one batch per so-called epoch, default300 updates.
findings.missing: Actual paper epoch/update count, exact five seeds, activation/dropout/weight decay choices, and whether all training windows are traversed per epoch.
